claire_sales: New POC request from a regulated payments customer. Requirements: streaming + function/tool calls that output NDJSON lines, strict JSON schema versioning, SSO (SAML preferred), CMK, and pilot pricing. Can eng/sec/ops confirm quick checklist and feasibility?

raj_eng: Quick clarifications: 1) inline function results vs async callbacks? 2) ordering per conversation required? 3) peak qps / token/day estimate?

claire_sales: Inline preferred for risk decisions, async callbacks ok for batch. Must have per-conversation ordering for audit. Expect ~40 qps peak and 150k tokens/day during pilot.

raj_eng: Implementation notes: use SSE streaming with event types: response_chunk, function_call, function_result. Server should stamp "schema_version" on function events. Client validates each NDJSON line before ingestion. Minimal JS example: const es = new EventSource(url); es.onmessage = e => { const obj = JSON.parse(e.data); /* validate obj.schema_version */ }

marta_sec: Security: SAML/OIDC + SCIM supported. For CMK: AWS/GCP KMS available on Dedicated/Private; hosted CMK via contract. Recommend short-lived API tokens, IP allowlist, and mTLS for webhook callbacks. On-prem HSM requires enterprise track and adds lead time.

noah_ops: Ops: to preserve ordering use Dedicated with session pinning. For NDJSON ingestion client should handle backpressure and streaming reconnects. We'll enable token-level cost views and export traces to their SIEM.

claire_sales: Pricing ask: pilot 1 month, 150k tokens/day streaming + functions. Any ballpark hosted vs dedicated?

raj_eng: Ballpark hosted: streaming ~ $0.0008/token -> 150k*30=4.5M tokens ~= $3.6k/mo (model dependent). Dedicated reserved capacity for ordering/SLA: expect ~$16k-22k/month for initial pool depending on region. We can propose a hybrid path.

marta_sec: Security review timeline: SAML + KMS + questionnaire ~2-3 weeks. Add 1-2 weeks for SCIM & webhook mTLS testing.

noah_ops: I'll queue a Dedicated sizing job if they commit. Also suggest a quantized fallback model for cost spikes (auto-failover at 95th pct).

raj_eng: Sending a short integration checklist: 1) Confirm model & token budget 2) Hosting mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) 3) SSO + SCIM 4) KMS (AWS/GCP/Redwood) 5) Webhook endpoints & certs (mTLS) 6) JSON schema(s) + versioning rules 7) Telemetry destination & retention 8) Pilot dates & success criteria

infra-bot: [task] Dedicated sizing job queued id ds-9921.

claire_sales: Thanks — I'll attach this checklist to SAQ reply and ask for NDA to share Private architecture diagram.
